description: DESTRUCTIVE — all data is lost. REQUIRES confirm = exact hostname (from get_vps_status) or 'DELETE'. Agent must explicitly confirm with the human before calling. Wipes and reinstalls the VPS with the given OS image (`os_id` from list_plans). Provisioning runs asynchronously; poll `get_vps_status`.

service_id.description: Service code as returned by list_vps/order_vps, e.g. "68J67T5" (a plain numeric id is also accepted).

name: reinstall_vps
title: Reinstall OS
